item.title: Democrats plan to widen their probes of fatal ICE shootings
item.description: The killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti during the ICE surge in Minneapolis last winter was a pivotal moment for the country. After Democrats' sweeping wins this week, their deaths at the hands of immigration agents will likely be the targets of renewed investigations.

item.title: An unexpected activist emerged to help block a $5 billion data center in Maryland
item.description: Thousands across the U.S. have gotten involved to oppose data centers. One is a Maryland woman who'd been evicted after a pay cut and became a leader of a community effort that blocked a vast project.

item.title: Why public schools nationwide are facing a massive drop in student enrollment
item.description: School enrollment was already expected to plunge by 2 million kids by 2030. Education experts say deporting immigrant families, many with school-age children, is making the crisis worse.

item.title: Former Army medic reflects on his toughest moments helping the wounded
item.description: Twenty years ago, Army Staff Sergeant Phillip Trezza deployed to Iraq as a medic. He speaks with his teenage daughter about some of his toughest moments.

item.title: A judge blocked construction of Trump's arch at the 11th hour. What's next?
item.description: The Trump administration had hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. Overnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
